statements.text: The proposer of the ops says the Arabic column heading refers to natural ground level, not finished ground level, and that the Arabic note 1 applies the limits to more than permanent structures. Because the reading is pending, neither claim can be confirmed. Until an approved reading exists, the limits and datum that bind the bidder are unknown, and this is insufficient evidence for a row reading.

payload.why: Note (3) requires notice at least thirty (30) days before a crane is erected, but does not say whether these are calendar days or Working Days. The proposer reports that the Arabic is also unqualified, and the Arabic reading is pending. The notice is also tied to crane erection, a post-award event, and the pack gives no date for it. A date rule cannot be set and the counting unit cannot be chosen. Insufficient evidence.
